surface_name: Make an API call (via Make), writes
title: Bigin write through 'Make an API call' fails with expected_data_type jsonobject
cause: Mapping a webhook's raw body into the module's body encodes the JSON a second time.
fix: Use the typed modules for writes: updateAPipeline, deleteAPipeline, deleteAContact.
affected: Make Bigin by Zoho app version 2, September 2026
